items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Mario was working with Jose Curbelo's father at the Summer Casino for two years

ctx.x: Okay. Ah - you and Mario never made it to Panama. What did you do after that in 1926?
1926? Well, Mario was working with Jose Curbelo's father at the Summer Casino for two years and then he worked at The Montmatre.
And what - and then what were you doing about that time?
